display.title: Expedition Exchange
description: Each realm has its own token: Tidebound Doubloons (ocean), Cinder Idols (Nether), Starlit Voidglass (End),
Skyward Plumes (Aether), Echoing Fossils (the Deep) and Honeyed Seals (Bumblezone).
6 tokens + 2 gem dust buy a &echosen&r Apotheosis gem at its lowest purity - then cut it up yourself.
This is targeted progress, not a shop: no affix gear, no top purities, and tokens cannot be crafted.
